profile_text: With 167 employees as of 2024, this Düsseldorf-based automotive retailer has experienced a 21.2% decline in growth since its baseline. Specializing in the wholesale and retail trade, as well as repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles, the company operates from its location on Königsberger Straße. Despite the decline, its categorization as a Gazelle suggests it has demonstrated rapid growth in the past, warranting continued monitoring of its performance.
